title: Prioritized Rollouts for Efficient World Model-based Vision-Language-Action Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.22879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied intelligence, but fine-tuning them with reinforcement learning (RL) remains constrained by the cost of real-world robot interaction. Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) reduces this cost by using a learned world model to generate rollouts for policy optimization. However, it becomes computationally expensive as VLA policies and world models scale. Existing methods typically treat states equally, overlooking substantial differences in their utility for policy improvement. In this paper, we show that policy uncertainty helps identify states with greater potential for policy improvement. The policy exhibits high uncertainty at only a small subset of states, often during decision-sensitive stages where small action differences can alter task outcomes, suggesting that policy improvements at these states could be particularly valuable. translated_title: 基于优先级轨迹采样的高效世界模型视觉-语言-动作策略优化
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为具身智能的一种强大范式，但使用强化学习（RL）对其进行微调仍然受到真实世界机器人交互成本的制约。基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）通过利用学习到的世界模型生成轨迹来降低这一成本，从而实现策略优化。然而，随着VLA策略和世界模型规模的扩大，其计算开销变得十分高昂。现有方法通常平等对待所有状态，忽视了它们在策略改进价值上的显著差异。在本文中，我们证明了策略不确定性有助于识别具有更大策略改进潜力的状态。策略仅在少数状态上表现出高不确定性，这些状态通常处于决策敏感阶段——在此阶段，微小的动作差异就可能改变任务结果，这表明在这些状态上进行策略改进可能特别有价值。基于这些发现，……
tldr: 该论文提出利用策略不确定性来识别决策敏感的关键状态，并对这些状态的世界模型轨迹采样进行优先级排序，从而显著降低VLA模型强化学习微调的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes prioritizing world model rollouts at states with high policy uncertainty—typically decision-sensitive stages where small action differences alter task outcomes—to enable efficient RL fine-tuning of VLA policies at reduced computational cost.
